title: Deleted Scene from Dirty Hands "The Art and Crimes of David Choe"
summary: A 2:46 deleted Dirty Hands mural tour centered on live collaboration. An unresolved primary voice says working with other artists demands immediate adaptation and illustrates that through not knowing how to draw dogs. The tour invents character lore for Todd, his girlfriend, bird shooting, tattooing and class mismatch; moves through “surreal estate,” dog-defecation, Metallica-on-a-shoebox, sushi, whales playing hopscotch, stair dwellers and a domestic escape gag; then explains adding little figures to fill space and repeat across the mural. Collaborative credit is explicit: Dave starts houses, the group continues them, clouds are copied, another artist draws them better, and additions link the whole work. Later voices invent magic expanding holes, nether worlds, a 23rd dimension, unusual-light visibility and an unclear cannon/chain/beast story. Every crude and fictional idea remains. Character lore is not biography, and no expanded Ro/Dave/RTG identity, censored word, proper noun, weapon/franchise or named voice is invented.
